_comment: Append-only price OBSERVATIONS. Each row records what was true, when, and where it came from -- never edited in place. A lane row storing only a computed total_cost_usd is unreadable once prices move, so lane rows store raw token counts and join here on (model, effective_from <= lane.lane_started_at < next effective_from). The join key is DISPATCH time, not extraction time.

REFRESH. Two mechanisms, and the cheap one covers most of it. (1) RECONCILE, continuously and for free: every lane row carries both the provider-reported cost and a cost derived from raw tokens against this table, so a divergence IS the price-change alarm and fires on the next run anyone makes. This is how the cache rates below were first recovered -- solving for the missing dimensions across four Opus lanes gave cache_read=0.1x input at a maximum residual of $0.0000, before any page was read. (2) FETCH, on a cadence, because reconciliation can only find rates for dimensions we already model and cannot discover a new one or a model-specific exception: WebFetch https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing monthly, and at every model launch or CLI upgrade window. The Fable 2.5% cache-read exception below is exactly what fetching catches and reconciling would not.

PROVIDERS THAT DO NOT REPORT COST. codex exec reports token counts but no cost, so there is nothing to reconcile against on that side and the fetch cadence is the only mechanism. Those rows are nulls until someone fills them from the vendor's published rates.

source: platform.claude.com models overview (input/output/cache-read ratio); cache_write_1h DERIVED from 4 observed lanes, residual $0.0000, not published-verified
platform.claude.com models overview; cache rates by the documented 10% read ratio and the derived 2.0x write ratio
platform.claude.com models overview; cache rates by documented ratio
platform.claude.com models overview -- EXCEPTION: Fable cache reads are 2.5% of input, NOT the 10% every other model uses. A global ratio misprices this model by 4x.
platform.claude.com models overview lists Fable 5 as legacy; cache-read ratio not stated for it -- do not assume the 5.1 exception applies
UNKNOWN -- codex exec reports tokens but not cost; nothing to reconcile against, needs a fetch
